segments.text: Supermarket car park. You've just found a space. Then something bounces off the car next to you.
It's a hailstone. The size of a football. And there are more coming. What do you do?
Most drivers think: quick, drive home! Faster than the hail!
But football hail loves a moving target. Bonk. Bonk. Bonk.
When you get home, your car has two hundred dimples. It looks like a giant golf ball. And your neighbour is already teeing off. Fore!
Here's how you do it properly.
Stay parked. Wipers on. Full speed.
Now your wipers are goalkeepers. Save! Save! What a save!
Every save lands in a shopping trolley. Ten trolleys, full of ice.
Then the hail stops. The sun comes out. And the supermarket has an idea.
Free slushies for the whole car park. And a giant one, for the goalkeeper.
Next exam question: a car transporter wants to load your car. Follow, so you don't miss it.
